d:
Evelyn decided to tempt fate by ordering a mysterious ancient potion that promised to fulfill her wildest fantasies of breast expansion. She eagerly awaited the package, but the results completely exceeded her expectations. The potion's effects hit so rapidly that the transformation began right in the middle of the street, catching her entirely off guard. Intoxicated by the incredible physical sensations and a sudden rush of pleasure, Evelyn decides not to hold back and fully surrenders to the process.

I decided to experiment with the format, and I ended up with a pretty simple comic about endless growth; I'll post the sequel for free in a little while 😊

I will be sincerely glad if you can support me on ▶ Patreon.com/SirNrei, There you'll find the next installment of this comic, as well as lots of other things. Thank you for your support.
